name: Tailwind Blob Morph
css:
.loader { display: inline-block; width: var(--loader-size); height: var(--loader-size); background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--loader-color), var(--loader-secondary-color)); animation: twMorph calc(var(--loader-speed) * 2.4) ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes twMorph { 0%, 100% { border-radius: 60% 40% 30% 70% / 60% 30% 70% 40%; transform: rotate(0deg); } 50% { border-radius: 30% 60% 70% 40% / 50% 60% 30% 60%; transform: rotate(180deg); } }
tailwind:
{/* keyframes twMorph: alternate the border-radius blob values and rotate(180deg) */}
<span className="inline-block h-15 w-15 animate-[twMorph_2.4s_ease-in-out_infinite] bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-500 to-pink-500" />
